title: 第25章 充分利用第26章 两个队友
content_zh:
其他小地方中来的新弟子，加入学院之后，首先要做的，肯定是积攒贡献值，然后兑换一门品阶较好的修炼功法！
因为功法对于武者，可以说是最重要的。
牧帆有《至尊神诀》，不缺功法，所以直接考虑如何提升修为，以及提升实力。
珍宝阁，位于四院的中心交汇处，里面可以购买各种东西，武者必不可少的丹药、灵器、灵药等等非常之多。
整个店铺，不是一般的大，像极了一个宽敞的交易市场。
里面负责维持秩序的管理人员，就足有十几位。
当然了，也没有哪个弟子敢来这儿闹事。
牧帆来到一处柜台前，说明来意之后，将身上所有有价值，并且自己用不到的东西都拿出来。
主要就是上千块灵石，以及几门武技，功法倒是没有，
管理人员道：“一千两百块灵石，可兑换一千两百点贡献值。
至于这六门武技，人阶的四门武技不值钱，灵阶的这两门倒是可以卖一些，就一共算你两千点贡献值好了，加一起就是三千二百点贡献值，你看怎么样？”
灵阶武技，在周云岭那种小地方，是有价无市，因此极为珍贵，来到这临水学院，价值直接跌了很多。
牧帆有些懊恼，没有在枉安城提前将武技兑换成灵石，眼下也只能同意了。
管理人员立即将贡献值转移到牧帆令牌中。
贡献值立马从一千六百，变化到了四千八百点。
主要还是很多势力中的灵阶武技，都是不传之秘，不可能卖掉，而牧帆手中的武技，是抢来的，只要自己用不上，就可以随便卖掉。
身上的贡献值暴涨，让牧帆底气多了几分，当即走入珍宝阁中逛起来，看看需要购买些什么。
目前的牧帆，功法不缺，灵器的话，惊鸿属于灵阶低级，也很适合使用。
武技方面，身法武技人阶高级的《风影步》还可以勉强使用，不着急换更高级的，剑类武技的话，《残阳剑法》才修炼到第二剑，自然不需要换。
武技的品质可不是越高越好，若是品质太高，根本无法修炼。

功法、武技、灵器都不缺。
于是牧帆便挑选了一枚二品丹药。
临水学院中，别说二品丹药了，哪怕是三品丹药，甚至是四品丹药都有，当然前提是买得起。
二品丹药太贵了，最次的二品低级都需要两千点以上的贡献值，牧帆忍痛购买了一枚很不错的二品低级青玄灵丹，服用之后可以给武者提供大量的灵气，增快修炼速度。
虽然肉痛，但是想到可以加快提升实力的速度，牧帆也只能买了。
随后，牧帆又花费了不少贡献值，购买了好几件大小相同的学院制服，以及学院内的日常用品，以便换用。
就购买了这么一点东西，牧帆刚刚才兑换过来的三千两百点贡献值就已经去得差不多了！
“果然贡献值消耗快啊！”
牧帆不由得感慨一声，原本是打算多购买一点的，不过想到去任何地方都需要花费贡献值，就没有继续购买。
低头看了一眼身份令牌，只有一千七百六十二点贡献值。
出了珍宝阁，牧帆没有着急返回千叶府，而是随意走动在东院中，打算熟悉一些新环境，谢玉就介绍了几个重要的场合，并不详细。
牧帆很快就了解到东院的大致。
对于修炼速度增幅最快的一处地方，是四院共享的炼气灵塔，据说炼气灵塔时刻以大量的灵气催动着，里面会有很强大的威压效果，修炼可以事半功倍。
只不过进入里面最底层修炼一天，都需要消耗好几百点贡献值！
content_en:
For new disciples from other small places, after joining the academy, the first thing they must do is to accumulate contribution points, and then redeem them for a better-grade cultivation technique!
Because Kung Fu can be said to be the most important to a warrior.
Mu Fan has the "Supreme Divine Art" and has no shortage of skills, so he directly considers how to improve his cultivation and strength.
The Treasure Pavilion is located at the central intersection of the four courtyards. You can buy all kinds of things in it. There are many elixirs, spiritual weapons, elixirs, etc. that are essential for warriors.
The entire store is not generally large, and looks like a spacious trading market.
There are more than a dozen managers responsible for maintaining order inside.
Of course, no disciple dares to come here to cause trouble.
Mu Fan came to a counter and after explaining his purpose, he took out all the valuable things on his body that he did not need.
The main ones are thousands of spiritual stones and a few martial arts, but not the exercises.
The manager said: "One thousand, two hundred spiritual stones can be exchanged for one thousand, two hundred contribution points.
As for these six martial arts, the four human-level martial arts are not valuable, but the two spiritual-level martial arts can be sold for some, so the total is calculated as your contribution value of 2,000 points, which adds up to 3,200 contribution points. What do you think? "
Spirit-level martial arts are priceless in a small place like Zhou Yunling, so they are extremely precious. When they come to Linshui Academy, their value has dropped a lot.
Mu Fan was a little annoyed that he didn't exchange his martial arts skills into spiritual stones in advance in Wu'an City, so he could only agree now.
The administrator immediately transfers the contribution value to Mufan tokens.
The contribution value immediately changed from 1,600 to 4,800 points.
The main reason is that the spiritual martial arts in many forces are secrets that are not passed down and cannot be sold. However, the martial arts in Mu Fan's hands were stolen and can be sold as long as he does not need them.
The sharp increase in his contribution value gave Mufan a little more confidence, and he immediately walked into the Treasure Pavilion to see what he needed to buy.
The current Mu Fan has no shortage of skills. As for spiritual weapons, Jinghong is a low-level spiritual weapon and is very suitable for use.
In terms of martial arts, the "Wind Shadow Step", which is a high-level body martial arts skill, can still be used reluctantly. There is no need to change to a more advanced one. As for sword martial arts, "Setting Sun Sword Technique" has only been practiced to the second sword, so naturally there is no need to change.
The higher the quality of martial arts, the better. If the quality is too high, it will be impossible to practice at all.
There is no shortage of techniques, martial arts, and spiritual weapons.
So Mu Fan chose a second-grade elixir.
In Linshui Academy, let alone second-grade elixirs, there are even third-grade elixirs and even fourth-grade elixirs, of course, provided you can afford them.
Second-grade elixirs were too expensive, and the lowest second-grade low-grade elixirs required more than 2,000 contribution points. Mu Fan reluctantly bought a very good second-grade low-grade Qingxuan Spiritual Pill. After taking it, it could provide a large amount of spiritual energy to the warrior and speed up his cultivation.
Although it hurts, Mu Fan can only buy it when he thinks that it can speed up the improvement of strength.
Later, Mufan spent a lot of contribution points to buy several college uniforms of the same size, as well as daily necessities in the college for replacement.
After purchasing just a few things, Mufan's 3,200 contribution points that he just redeemed are almost gone!
"Sure enough, the contribution points are consumed quickly!"
Mu Fan couldn't help but sigh. He originally planned to buy more, but when he thought about the contribution points needed to go anywhere, he didn't continue to buy.
He looked down at the identity token and saw that it only had one thousand, seven hundred and sixty-two contribution points.
After leaving the Treasure Pavilion, Mu Fan was not in a hurry to return to Qianba Mansion. Instead, he walked around the east courtyard casually, intending to get familiar with some new surroundings. Xie Yu introduced several important occasions without going into details.
Mu Fan soon learned the general outline of the East Courtyard.
The place with the fastest increase in cultivation speed is the Qi Refining Spirit Pagoda shared by the four courtyards. It is said that the Qi Refining Spirit Pagoda uses a large amount of energy at all times.When activated by spiritual energy, there will be a very powerful coercive effect inside, so practicing can get twice the result with half the effort.
It's just that entering the lowest level to practice for a day requires spending hundreds of contribution points!
